reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getScheduledAmount and getApproxNumberThreshold and routes the previously inlined midpoint copies (forecast, schedules app x2, preview, schedule-template) and the API through them.

duplication.why: The five inlined midpoint copies are removed, but schedule-template keeps its own 'isbetween || isapprox ? helper : value' dispatch around the helper, repeating a decision the helper already makes.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, but expectedAmount is bolted on in the api.ts handler with an ad-hoc intersection type instead of in scheduleModel.toExternal/APIScheduleEntity where the external schedule shape is defined.

scope.why: Edits are confined to amount resolution, its call sites, the API field, tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: Every caller now passes a positional 'false' to reach the op argument, and after the step-4 rule change several comments and the approx release note still say 'end furthest from zero', contradicting the code.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList decides by op itself whether to call getScheduledAmount; api.ts adds expectedAmount outside scheduleModel.toExternal

disguised_duplication.where: none; the remaining op check in schedule-template is a visible redundant guard, not a reshaped copy

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gained an op parameter (a real variation); schedule-template.ts keeps an outer op dispatch around the helper
